title: Artifacts
coreMove: Teams get value from artifacts when current information supports decisions, coordination, compliance, learning, or control; stale or unused records are theater, not management.

exampleSpecs.domain: weekly governance review with a risk register on screen
exampleSpecs.audience: a PMO lead trying to keep artifact review tied to decisions
exampleSpecs.stakes: prevent a completed register from being mistaken for active risk response
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist interrupts his own checklist routine and restarts from who uses the risk register

exampleSpecs.domain: team workspace with a Kanban board and delivery dashboard
exampleSpecs.audience: a coordinator observing flow before a daily team conversation
exampleSpecs.stakes: show how visible work state teaches without a decision fork
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a close observed detail shows WIP and bottlenecks before anyone explains them

exampleSpecs.domain: postmortem after an unresolved supplier risk delays delivery
exampleSpecs.audience: an analyst reconstructing the decisive artifact failure
exampleSpecs.stakes: locate the misstep that turned a listed risk into unmanaged uncertainty
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the failure has already happened and the trace points to a green risk row with no real response

exampleSpecs.domain: delivery lead presenting a dashboard beside a Kanban board
exampleSpecs.audience: a delivery lead responsible for current measurement signals
exampleSpecs.stakes: recover from presenting stale performance data before the group relies on it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist notices her own stale dashboard while the live Kanban board shows a bottleneck

exampleSpecs.domain: project manager documenting which artifacts the team will keep
exampleSpecs.audience: a project manager explaining artifact choices to a sponsor
exampleSpecs.stakes: justify a fit-for-purpose artifact set without copying the whole catalog
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the written memo carries the scene by naming use before inventory

exampleSpecs.domain: two project leads responding to the same sponsor request for status visibility
exampleSpecs.audience: leads choosing whether visibility means more artifacts or better-used artifacts
exampleSpecs.stakes: show how opposite artifact strategies produce different outcomes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: two named people face the same request with opposite approaches and outcomes diverge
